name: OLDER BROTHER SIMULATOR 2002
source:
It's 2002 and it's freezing.

In this short game, you play as Ranger, a nerdy senior in high school that has a sexual arrangement with track-and-field star Ethan. When Ranger bikes to his house in the Oregon woods and Ethan doesn't show up, he takes respite in the warm apartment above the garage of Ethan's older brother Lukey. Lukey is crass, stoned, and spends all day playing hockey video games and listening to Linkin Park. And it seems that Lukey's taken a liking to Ranger.

With three endings, you can fall under the spell of Lukey, break down his walls, or find a way to woo him. This game contains two different adult scenes, rendered in beautiful 480p PS2-inspired 3D.

Grab your camera phone, tune into season 4 of Survivor, and play some Eminem, because it's 2002 again.

[From [url=https://wannabeyourdog2.itch.io/older-brother-simulator-2002]Itch.io[/url]]
